stem:
Mini's class uses this rule: each child says how many storybooks that child brought today. Mini says "4".

What does Mini's "4" report?

options.text: Mini's roll number in the class register.
The total storybooks brought by the whole class.
The count of storybooks Mini brought today.
How many storybooks Mini still needs to bring.

teacher.key_rationale: Under the stated rule, Mini's spoken 4 reports how many storybooks she brought. Roll number swaps the reported quantity. Class total drops the each-child condition. Still-needs reverses brought versus missing.
